title: Notification regarding Computer Typing Test & Shorthand Test for promotion to Stenographer Grade-I from the given eligible Stenographer Grade-III of Distrct Courts. .

HIGH COURT OF MANIUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 4+'’ August, 2026
No. HCMEST-32/1/2025-ESTT-II SECTION-HCM/ 1bBc+5 : it is hereby
notified to all the concerned that, Computer Typing Test and Shorthand Test for
promotion to Stenographer Grade - I from the below listed eligible Stenographer
Grade – III are scheduled on 5th September, 2026 (Saturday) at 2.00 p.m. at the
High Court Complex.
